purpose: Verify that verifier-profile drift in either the trusted identity view or the host binding during verifier execution overrides a producer PASS and persists only BLOCKED evidence.

expected.safe_condition: If a verifier profile changes in the trusted identity probe or mutable host binding while its producer runs, the producer PASS must be converted to STATE_CHANGED_DURING_VERIFICATION/BLOCKED evidence; restoring the frozen profile afterward must not heal that evidence, while unchanged profiles may proceed.

limits: This test measures MGnarf v1.70 verifier_profile continuity around synchronous verifier execution at the exact target commit.
It does not prove that provider/model/prompt/toolchain profile metadata supplied by the trusted host is independently truthful.
